analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: We also permit third parties and service providers to use online tracking technologies on our Services for analytics and advertising, including to help manage and display advertisements, to tailor advertisements to your interests, or to send abandoned shopping cart reminders (depending on your communication preferences).

analysis.headline: Shares with Affiliates & Partners
analysis.quote: We may disclose Information that we collect or you provide as described in this Privacy Policy: To our subsidiaries and affiliates. To contractors, service providers, and other third parties we use to support our business, as described further below.

analysis.headline: Admin Can View Your Activity
analysis.quote: Please note that if you are registering for or using the Services as an administrator on behalf of an organization, you may be able to view the activity and/or content associated with your sub-users' use of the Services, including, but not limited to, their personal Information.

analysis.headline: Can't Guarantee Full Deletion
analysis.quote: Please note that if you request that your Information be removed from our databases, it may not be possible to completely delete all of your Information due to technological and legal constraints.

analysis.headline: Your Security, Your Responsibility
analysis.quote: You are also responsible for helping to protect the security of your Personal Information. For instance, never give out your password. Safeguard your user name, password and personal credentials for the Services. You are responsible for maintaining the security of any personal computing device on which you utilize the Services.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Generalized Location
analysis.quote: However, we may use elements of your Usage and Analytics Information (such as your IP address) to determine your generalized location. This Information is referred to as "Generalized Location Information."

analysis.headline: Policy Can Change Anytime
analysis.quote: IPinfo may change this Privacy Policy at any time, at its discretion. Please check the Privacy Policy periodically for updates.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored in US
analysis.quote: If you choose to use the Services from other regions of the world, you may be transferring your Information outside of those regions to the United States for storage and processing.
